meta.title: RS Studio — Scalable, performant software
meta.description: A small software studio building scalable, performant products. We work as an embedded team or run projects end-to-end, from architecture to the release you actually ship.

hero.title: We're RS Studio
hero.intro: A small software studio building scalable, performant products. We work as an embedded team or run projects end‑to‑end — from architecture to the release you actually ship.

items.title: Product engineering
items.body: Full builds from first commit to production — web, mobile, and the API underneath.

items.title: Scaling & performance
items.body: Profiling, query work, caching and infra changes on systems that outgrew their first design.

items.title: Embedded team
items.body: We join your sprints, your repo, your standups — with senior judgement, not just hands.

items.title: Technical audits
items.body: A clear read on architecture, risk and cost, with a prioritised plan you can act on.

process.title: How we work
process.intro: Short cycles, visible progress, no surprises at the end. You get a working build every week.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: A short paid discovery: goals, constraints, and what we are not building.

steps.title: Shape
steps.body: Architecture, data model and a milestone plan you can hold us to.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Weekly deploys to a staging URL. You see progress, not status reports.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.body: Documented code, CI, and a team that knows how to run it without us.

contact.title: Have something to build?
contact.intro: Tell us the problem and the deadline. We'll reply within two business days with a plan and an honest estimate.

whatsapp.label: Chat with us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.message: Hi! I've seen your website and I'd like to know more about your services!
